Write an openxlsx workbook atomically

Source: R/digitizer_fishmorph.R
write_workbook_atomic.Rd

The openxlsx counterpart of write_xlsx_atomic(), for a workbook EDITED in place (loaded with openxlsx::loadWorkbook(), so its other sheets and columns are carried along): written to a temporary file in the same directory, then renamed over the target; the previous generation is kept as "<name>.prev.xlsx" and restored if the rename fails. Used by digitize_fishmorph_reference() for the FISHMORPH workbook, and by FishInTrait (it replaces Rfishmorph::fm_save_workbook_atomic()).

Usage

write_workbook_atomic(wb, path, keep_prev = TRUE)

Arguments

wb

An openxlsx Workbook object.

path

Target path.

keep_prev

Keep the previous generation (default TRUE).

Value

TRUE, invisibly.

See also

write_xlsx_atomic()
